verdict_reason: The re-baselined counts match the recaptured fixture's seven 0102 species, but the test asserts hand-copied counts rather than the species its title says it lists.

todos.issue: Title 'Should list every species of a code found by its code, a page at a time' claims every species is listed, but lines 73-79 assert only counts (total 7, page lengths 5 and 2) copied by hand from fixtures/commodities.json's 0102 group. A search returning the wrong 7 species still passes, and every MDM recapture forces another hand re-count, which is why this PR had to edit the numbers.
todos.fix: Must: the test proves that the two pages together hold exactly the 0102 group's species, in data order, with the expectation taken from the fixture rather than a hand-copied count. One way: read the 0102 group from COMMODITY_GROUPS (exported by stub.js), assert firstPage.total equals its species length, and assert [...firstPage.groups[0].species, ...secondPage.groups[0].species] toEqual that group's species.
